senses.gloss: pr. n. m. Javan, son of Japheth, progenitor of the Grecian tribes, in gen. Greek, Greece;

units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 10:2">Targ. Gen. X, 2</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 15:12">Targ. Y. Gen. XV, 12</cite>.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 44:17">Gen. R. s. 44</cite> (ref. to <he>איל משלש</he>, <cite ref="Genesis 15:9">Gen. XV, 9</cite>) <he>זו י׳</he> this alludes to the Greek government (founded by Alexander the Great).

<cite ref="Genesis 15:9">Ib.</cite> <he>כל רוחות כבשו בני י׳ וכ׳</he> in all directions did the Greeks conquer, except in the East. Esth. R. introd. <he>בבקרה של י׳</he> when Greece (Syria) is in the ascendancy, v. <cite ref="B01138"><he>בֹּקֶר</he></cite>; a. fr.—Denom. <cite ref="J00206"><he>יְוָנִי</he></cite>, <cite ref="J00201"><he>יְוָנָאָה</he></cite>.
